schedule.noDatesChanged: no dates in this period (the date was changed or removed from the calendar)

chatTarget.seat: in the chats with the leaders
chatTarget.seatNamed: in the chat with the leaders “{name}”

auto.confirmHelp: After opening the link the person reviews their data — especially the contacts — and confirms it with one button.
auto.officeFills: Filled in by the coordinator — the person doesn't see it.

booking.noneTitle: {label} — the person hasn't chosen a date yet
booking.pick: You choose the date in the booking.
booking.pickIn: You choose the date in the booking “{name}”.

sheet.title: Attendance list
sheet.hint: Tasks with dates from the calendar: who will be there, who doesn't know yet, who won't — and after the date, who was there.
sheet.noDates: There are no dates in the task's period — the date was changed or removed from the calendar.

list.nothing: There is nothing to do here.
list.confirmHint: Review your data in the registration and confirm it.
list.officeTicks: The office ticks this off when it receives it.
list.learnReached: Learning up to {pct}% knowledge — reached. Progress: Learning → knowledge base → Progress.
list.learnNotYet: Learning up to {pct}% knowledge — not yet. Progress: Learning → knowledge base → Progress.

card.noDays: There are no days of this task in this period (the date was changed or removed from the calendar).
card.how: Click a day: once — <yes>yes</yes>, twice — <no>no</no>, three times — <maybe>I don't know yet</maybe>, four times — no answer.
card.whatDo: what do you want to do?
card.noDates: There are no dates in this period (the date was changed or removed from the calendar).

problem.item: choose a date from the calendar
problem.capacity: people per role: a number from 1 to 500 or empty

editor.unbooked: Marker “{name}”: choose where the person picks a date.
editor.unlearned: Marker “{name}”: choose the library the person should learn from.
editor.noKey: Tasks and markers are sealed with the key of the form's area — set the area in “Settings” or open the form with an account that reads this area.
editor.unreadable: Some tasks or markers cannot be read with this key — saving will overwrite them.
editor.tasksHint: The person answers in the calendar for each day of the task; the office sees it with the person and can enter it for them.
editor.marksHint: What doesn't show in the data (“Parental consent delivered”). Ticked off by the office, by the person through their link — or by the marker itself (a chosen date, messages read).
editor.markHelpHint: e.g. The consent form is in the sacristy.
editor.byBooking: itself — when the person chooses a date
editor.byChat: itself — when the person reads the messages
editor.byLearn: itself — when the person has learned (knowledge base)
editor.unnamed: Tasks and markers without a name won't be saved.
editor.autoHint: From the person's link and from sub-forms — shown with every person.
editor.confirmWho: the person, after first opening the link
editor.personFills: filled in by the person through their link
editor.officeFills: filled in by the coordinator, the person doesn't see it
editor.noQuestions: no questions — doesn't count until you add some
editor.mapNote: You arrange the person's steps on the page — in the “Page logic map”, under the modules: each step is a node that is done when what you connect to it is met. The map can use tasks and markers as inputs (“Marker”; a task counts when the person has marked enough days).
editor.taskHelp: Description for the person — where, what to bring (optional)
editor.once: once, on any day of the period
editor.fromCalendar: dates from the calendar (meeting, service, celebration)
editor.itemHint: The person will see this entry's dates from the period above — moved as in the calendar, without cancelled ones. A series (e.g. weekly meetings): set the period from which the dates count.
editor.askEach: Ask before each date: I'll be there / I don't know yet / I won't be there
editor.dutiesHint: Roles to choose for those who will come (e.g. altar servers: cross, candles, incense) — empty “people”: no limit.
editor.answerEachDate: the person answers for every date (I'll be there / I won't)
editor.answerEachDay: the person answers for every day (yes / no)
editor.presentTimes: present a set number of times
editor.doneTimes: done a set number of times
editor.emptyItem: (empty: at once · until a week after the end)
editor.emptyPlan: (empty: from the start of the period · until a week after the end)
editor.previewItem: The person will see the dates from the period {period}{ask}{duty}.
editor.previewAsk: and answer before each: I'll be there / I don't know yet / I won't be there
